episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a couple of healing massages, Bok Man-huem invites Do Da-hae to a dinner, where a fight ensues. Da-hae later recounts her findings to the gang.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Da-hae helps Bok Gwi-ju shop for a gift, who in turn shows up during her time of need. Soon, during an involuntary date, they receive a call for help.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Gwi-ju begins to revisit past memories, which share a surprising similarity. Da-hae moves into the Bok residence, finding friction among its members.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Da-hae experiences larger-than-life occurences at the Bok residence. Gwi-ju catches Da-hae red-handed, but later begins to open up about his secrets.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Da-hae attempts to fool Gwi-ju into a union, despite his skepticism. She later visits Bok I-na at her school which triggers a trauma from her past.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Gwi-ju tries to win Da-hae over after recent ordeals force her to pull away. But as Da-hae gets close to her goal, Bok Dong-hee finds damning evidence.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Even after the disastrous recent event, Gwi-ju keeps revisiting his past with Da-hae. Meanwhile, Baek Il-hong sees another opportunity to strike.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Despite Da-hae's objections, Gwi-ju pushes for more quality time with her. Soon, Il-hong's gang finds themselves becoming more entangled with the Boks.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Il-hong's plan to fracture the Bok family begins to take effect, forcing Da-hae to confront her. Da-hae and Gwi-ju later search for the missing I-na.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Man-huem's frightening premonition forces her to give somber news to the family. During a road trip, Gwi-ju and Da-hae experience a momentous incident.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: While Gwi-ju's fate becomes known to everyone, his family and Da-hae resolve to keep him safe. Da-hae and Grace Kang help Dong-hee find her worth.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As Gwi-ju awaits the inevitable, catastrophe strikes I-na's dance competition. Can Gwi-ju fulfill his ultimate purpose before it's too late?
